# Clear the feed selection before changing a setup preference

When a feed test changes a display preference as setup or restoration, clear threadTree selection first so the change does not also reload the displayed message. Keep the message selected when the test intentionally exercises a display-mode change. The owned patch adds this ordering before clearUserPref and onSelectPref assignments. Current website visibility helpers retain the ordering; current select-mode tasks use pushPrefEnv and clear at task end. The setter calls ReloadMessage and the preference observer schedules timeoutReload. These are scoped source facts and a test-writing proposal, not a reproduced leak, a production leak diagnosis or a blanket ban on changing preferences with a message open. No test or leak checker ran.

Scope: mail feed browser test lifecycle.
